_comment: HELD-OUT intent/field cases. WHY this file exists: the intent classifier in retrieval/query_understanding.py was written while looking at eval_set.json, so scoring it on that set measures memorisation as much as generalisation - and it produced a suspicious field MRR of exactly 1.000. These are alternative natural phrasings of the same information needs, over drugs already verified present in the corpus. Weaker than truly independent authorship (the same person wrote the patterns and these paraphrases), but it is the difference between 'fits the data it was tuned on' and 'fits data it has not seen'. Treat a drop here as the honest number.

cases.q: how much amoxicillin should be given
how many mg of lamotrigine per day
what quantity of ondansetron is normal
is naproxen hard on the stomach
what condition does ropinirole help with
why would someone be on sertraline
how does atorvastatin function in the body
by what route does omeprazole act
is warfarin safe with other medicines
does sertraline clash with other drugs
can lamotrigine be given alongside other treatment
